description: ​Répartition par genre de l’effectif is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Répartition par genre de l’effectif au 31 décembre depuis 2010. Précisions spécifiques sur les ressources humaines au sein de SNCF: "Agents au statut": également désigné par "cadre permanent" à l’intérieur de SNCF, cette notion désigne une position statutaire, quelque soit le collège de l’agent, conforme aux dispositions de la directive interne RH 001 ("Statut des ... Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Social et ressources humaines. Its keywords are Social, Ressources humaines, Effectifs, Direction Cohésion. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
